fullPassage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. He felt uncertain about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed interesting to him. One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster caught his eye. The handwritten letters on every poster were elegant and beautiful. He became fascinated with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy, and decided to attend a calligraphy class. He gained an understanding of letter styles and learned to adjust the spacing between various combinations of letters. At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be useful or applicable to his life in the future. However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he incorporated what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually appealing letter styles. The artistic letters became a sensation at the time and are still widely used. His innovative incorporation of calligraphy into the world of technology, which started from his personal interest, has inspired many other corporations' computer system designs.

questions.passage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. He felt (A)[uncertain / confident] about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed (B)[interesting / boring] to him. One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster (C)[caught / lost] his eye. The handwritten letters on every poster were elegant and beautiful. He became fascinated with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy, and decided to attend a calligraphy class.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① confident(자신감 있는): uncertain의 반의어.
✅ ② uncertain — interesting — caught: 원문 일치.
❌ ③ boring(지루한): interesting의 반의어.
❌ ④ lost(잃다): caught의 반의어. 'lost his eye'는 문맥 불가.
det.tip: uncertain(불확실한) ↔ confident(확신하는), catch one's eye = 눈길을 끌다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:

✅ ② elegant — fascinated — adjust: 원문 일치.
❌ ③ crude — fascinated — adjust: crude(거친)는 elegant의 반의어.

det.tip: elegant(우아한) ↔ crude(거친), fascinated(매료된) ↔ bored(지루한), adjust(조정하다) ↔ ignore(무시하다)

det.analysis: incorporate(v. 반영하다/통합하다) → incorporation(n. 통합/접목). 형용사 innovative 뒤에 명사가 필요.
det.tip: incorporate(v.) → incorporation(n.). 'His innovative incorporation' = 형용사+명사 구조. 동사→명사 변환에 주의.

questions.passage: When Steve Jobs was a college student, he did not know what he wanted to do in the future. He felt uncertain about how the normal classes he was required to take could help him figure out what to do with his life. He decided to start checking out things that seemed interesting to him. One day, he was walking around the college grounds and a poster ____. The handwritten letters on every poster were elegant and beautiful. He became fascinated with the art of producing beautiful handwriting, also known as calligraphy, and decided to attend a calligraphy class. He gained an understanding of letter styles and learned to adjust the spacing between various combinations of letters. At that time, he did not expect that learning it would be useful or applicable to his life in the future. However, later when he developed his own computer operating system, he incorporated what he learned from that class into designing the system. As a result, he developed his own computer system with visually appealing letter styles. The artistic letters became a sensation at the time and are still widely used. His innovative incorporation of calligraphy into the world of technology, which started from his personal interest, has inspired many other corporations' computer system designs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① caught his eye: 흥미로운 것을 찾던 중 포스터가 눈에 띈 것. 관용표현.
❌ ② felt uncertain about: 'a poster felt uncertain about'은 문법적으로 불가.
❌ ③ gained an understanding of: 'a poster gained an understanding of'는 문맥 부적합.
❌ ④ became fascinated with: 'a poster became fascinated with'은 주어-의미 부적합.
det.tip: catch one's eye = attract one's attention = 눈길을 끌다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① developed: 'developed what he learned ... into designing'은 구문 부적합.
✅ ② incorporated: 'incorporate A into B' = A를 B에 반영하다. 원문 일치.
❌ ③ learned: 'learned what he learned'는 의미 중복.
❌ ④ gained: 'gained what he learned ... into designing'은 구문 부적합.
det.tip: incorporate = include = integrate (통합하다/반영하다). 'incorporate A into B' = A를 B에 반영하다.
